name: Buffalo Pound Provincial Park - Maple Vale, Shady Lane and Trails End Campgrounds
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19, Maple Vale + Shady Lane A/B + Trails End only. Buffalo Pound Lake is a reservoir: measured to the high-water edge (the sand/beach line or the vegetated fringe). Esri World_Imagery z18 (0.37 m/px) frames of the Shady Lane B and Trails End shore and a z16 frame of the whole group, all with every SKPP GIS site point plotted: nightly Shady Lane B S40 lies about 23 m from the sand edge across open mown grass, S42 about 39 m across open grass with scattered single trees, and nightly Trails End T13 about 22 m across open grass to a narrow strip of tall grass at the water; SKPP site photos of T13 show open grass to the lake. The other shore-side nightly sites look at the lake over or through shrubs and trees: T11 and T16 over low shrubs, T15 behind a thicket about 28 m deep, S30 and S32 behind a patchy shrub fringe 20-25 m out, S34, S36 and S38 through trees; the remaining shore sites are seasonal. Maple Vale and Shady Lane A sit 300 m+ up the valley side, inland. Every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'; re-audited on imagery and photos: three named nightly sites on open ground within 50 m of the water. The SKPP photos of the S30-S42 posts still read 'Site Occupied By Seasonal Camper', though the booking site now lists them 'Looking For Category: Nightly'. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290170, read 2026-11-19 (whole-park paging table, 285 rows, + every site's detail page): Maple Vale 59 (56 Nightly Electric + 3 accessible), Shady Lane A 20 (16 Nightly Electric + 4 seasonal), Shady Lane B 39 (7 Nightly Electric S30-S42 even numbers + 30 seasonal electric + 2 seasonal full service S35F and S57F), Trails End 63 (54 Nightly Electric + 1 accessible + 8 seasonal) = 181 site-specific sites, 137 by the night; 'Allowed Equipment' takes a 19-25 ft unit or larger on 109 nightly sites (32-40 ft on most of Maple Vale, Shady Lane B and Trails End; most of Shady Lane A posted at 15-18 ft). Park map (2026-04-10): one campground road from the Maple Vale entrance 'To Shady Lane and Trails End Campground', service centres with showers in Trails End and Shady Lane B, a service centre and grey-water disposal in Maple Vale. Elmview/Lakeside/Valley and Lower Chalet are now their own entries. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campgrounds at the north-west end of the park on Buffalo Pound Lake, a reservoir in the Qu'Appelle Valley about 20 minutes northeast of Moose Jaw: Maple Vale up the valley side by the store, Shady Lane and Trails End on open slopes down to the shore. Shady Lane B's S40 and S42 and Trails End's T13 sit on open grass close to the water; the other shore sites look at the lake through shrubs or trees or are seasonal (44 Shady Lane and Trails End sites are). Most Shady Lane A sites are posted for units of 18 ft or less. No dump station in these loops; the park's is by Elmview. Elmview, Lakeside and Valley by the beach about 2.8 km southeast, and Lower Chalet, have their own entries. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates. Full services May 14 to September 30; October camping on electric sites with pit and portable toilets, booked through the park. Winter camping is at Elmview.

fees.note: $4 a night less from October 1, with reduced services.

curation_note: Split 2026-11-19: this id kept Maple Vale + Shady Lane A/B + Trails End (181 sites, the larger group), re-pinned from 50.5947,-105.4126 (the boat-launch lot by Valley/Elmview) onto Shady Lane A site S18 by the group's centroid, 2.88 km away. Elmview + Lakeside + Valley (65 sites, centroid 2.78 km southeast, own road off the beach area, runs the winter camping) and Lower Chalet A + B (27 non-electric sites, 2.38 km beyond, own spurs off the main park road) became new entries. Within this group the loops chain along one campground road (Maple Vale-Shady Lane A 0.64 km, Shady Lane A-B 0.47 km, B-Trails End 0.32 km), so they stay together. --Claude
